17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2701-15 W. Touhy Ave. — Substitute

Proposed Zoning: © B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: 21,501 square feet (irregular lot shape)

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a new four-
story residential building that will contain forty-three (43) dwelling units.
Forty-five (45) off-street parking spaces and one (1) loading berth will be
provided to support the proposed multi-unit residential building. The
building will be masonry in construction and measure 60 ft. in height.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 52,117 square feet (2.42 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 501.37 square feet per D.U.
(43 residential units

proposed)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 45 parking spaces

@) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: none
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 3 feet and 4 inches
East Side: 1 foot and 4 inches
c. *Rear Setback: 1 foot and 4 inches

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0300, the Applicant is required to reduce the rear setback
for floors containing residential uses from the required 30 ft. to 1 ft.-4 inches.

(E) Building Height: 60 feet
